summary_1line: Elizabeth’s letter updates Victor on family and Justine, while Victor recovers, avoids science, studies languages with Clerval, and regains temporary happiness in nature.

image_candidates.scene_text: Victor reads Elizabeth’s heartfelt letter in his chamber while still weak from illness, sunlight falling across the page.
Clerval and Victor walk through blooming spring fields outside Ingolstadt, flowers along the hedges and distant peasants dancing.
